guidance_for_write_dockerfile_agent: The Dockerfile fails to build successfully because the 'apt-get install' command returns exit code 137, indicating that the process was terminated by the system, likely due to out-of-memory (OOM) or insufficient resources during the installation of many packages. To fix this, consider reducing memory usage during build, for example by limiting parallel jobs or splitting the RUN command into smaller parts to reduce the peak memory footprint.
